note: Part 3 BORDER inside the demo at an arbitrary frame within the part's dwell. Frame-independent checks only: the DYSP sprites bob on sines and the scroller moves, so every sprite position and text check of the standalone test/expect-p3.json is dropped. What is kept comes from p3_border.asm's own constants: BORDER_COL 11 (dark grey, so that the open band shows the black background), the band BAND_TOP 51 for 150 lines (51 to 200), bars at X 0 and rings at X 344 that end at vic_x 367, so the strip vic_x 368 to 375 never carries a sprite pixel, and the lowest sprite row is line 200. Until 2026-09-23 this file was written for the dummy p3, expected a black border, and failed on the first verify.sh run against the real module (the border read 11 on both models); it never graded the real part.
